scope: Fix Text Run Color Application in setHyperlink and Verify showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js (Lines 121-127)

tasks.title: Audit showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js (lines 121-127) and setHyperlink parameter parsing
tasks.description: Inspect lines 121-127 of showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js to determine how arguments and styling options are passed into setHyperlink. Audit src/managers/HyperlinkManager.js and PPTXTemplater.js to ensure setHyperlink resolves color from all argument patterns (options.color, options.style?.color, options.fontColor, options.style?.fontColor) and preserves the value through run splitting.

tasks.title: Fix hex color sanitization and DrawingML srgbClr generation
tasks.description: Ensure hex color strings such as '#F43F5E' are sanitized by stripping any leading '#' and converting shorthand 3-digit hex to 6-digit uppercase hex ('F43F5E'). When '#' is retained in val='#F43F5E', PowerPoint considers it invalid ST_HexColorRGB and reverts to the default hyperlink theme blue (#0563C1). Ensure <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val='F43F5E'/></a:solidFill> is generated.

tasks.title: Enforce strict ECMA-376 child element ordering inside <a:rPr>
tasks.description: Enforce strict ECMA-376 schema sequence inside <a:rPr>. Text fill elements (<a:solidFill>) must precede <a:uFill> and <a:hlinkClick>. If <a:hlinkClick> precedes <a:solidFill>, PowerPoint defaults the text color to theme blue or reports a corruption error. Ensure existing <a:schemeClr> elements on the split run are completely replaced by <a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val='F43F5E'/></a:solidFill>.

tasks.title: Verify showcase/output/hyperlinks_advanced.pptx XML and color rendering
tasks.description: Run `node showcase/hyperlinks_advanced.js` to generate showcase/output/hyperlinks_advanced.pptx. Unpack and inspect ppt/slides/slideN.xml to confirm the target text run contains <a:rPr><a:solidFill><a:srgbClr val='F43F5E'/></a:solidFill>...<a:hlinkClick .../></a:rPr>. Verify in PowerPoint that the text displays in rose color (#F43F5E) instead of default blue without any repair warning dialogs.
